category_title: Middle school students with IDD who independently navigate UDL literacy environments using audio supports and social features
scenario_title: Disappointment when checking for peer notifications
minimal_context: The student is logging into the Udio digital platform to begin their session and check for peer comments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to begin our Udio session today. Please log in to the platform.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Independently navigates the environment) I am going to check my notifications first to see if I got any comments from my friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and look at your dashboard.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: There are no notifications here. I pointed my peers to the comments I posted yesterday and reminded them to respond.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows evident disappointment) I don't want to work on any articles or projects right now. It is really disappointing that nobody wrote back to me.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to begin our Udio session today. Please log in to the platform.

STUDENT: (Independently navigates the environment) I am going to check my notifications first to see if I got any comments from my friends.

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead and look at your dashboard.

STUDENT: There are no notifications here. I pointed my peers to the comments I posted yesterday and reminded them to respond.

TUTOR: What do you think you should do next?

STUDENT: (Shows evident disappointment) I don't want to work on any articles or projects right now. It is really disappointing that nobody wrote back to me.

task.content: Checking notifications of whether they had received comments from peers

context.materials: Dashboard, article and project discussion areas
context.social_setting: Online socializing that carried over to offline contexts
context.time_context: First task they chose when beginning Udio sessions

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Pointed their peers to comments they had posted, reminding them to respond
